# Offline diagram rendering

`mermaid.min.js` is Mermaid 10.9.3 from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mermaid@10.9.3/dist/mermaid.min.js. The MIT license is in `MERMAID_LICENSE`. The slide renderer embeds this bundle in the HTML so diagrams render when opened locally without network access. Diagram source remains in Markdown fenced blocks.
